description: Open Data Platform for analysts, quants and AI agents.
readmeExcerpt:
Open Data Platform by OpenBB (ODP) is the open-source toolset that helps data engineers integrate proprietary, licensed, and public data sources into downstream applications like AI copilots and research dashboards. ODP operates as the "connect once, consume everywhere" infrastructure layer that consolidates and exposes data to multiple surfaces at once: Python environments for quants, OpenBB Workspace and Excel for analysts, MCP servers for AI agents, and REST APIs for other applications.
Get started with: `pip install openbb` ```python from openbb import obb output = obb.equity.price.historical("AAPL") df = output.to_dataframe() ``` Data integrations available can be found here: --- ## OpenBB Workspace While the Open Data Platform provides the open-source data integration foundation, **OpenBB Workspace** offers the enterprise UI for analysts to visualize datasets and leverage AI agents. The platform's "connect once, consume everywhere" architecture enables seamless integration between the two. You can find OpenBB Workspace at .
Data integration: - You can learn more about adding data to the OpenBB workspace from the [docs](https://docs.openbb.co/workspace) or [this open source repository](https://github.com/OpenBB-finance/backends-for-openbb). AI Agents integration: - You can learn more about adding AI agents to the OpenBB workspace from [this open source repository](https://github.com/OpenBB-finance/agents-for-openbb). ### Integrating Open Data Platform to the OpenBB Workspace Connect this library to the OpenBB Workspace with a few simple commands, in a Python (3.9.21 - 3.12) environment. #### Run an ODP backend - Install the packages. ```sh pip install "openbb[all]" ``` - Start the API server over localhost. ```sh openbb-api ``` This will launch a FastAPI server, via Uvicorn, at `127.0.0.1:6900`. You can check that it works by going to . #### Integrate the ODP Backend to OpenBB Workspace Sign-in to the [OpenBB Workspace](https://pro.openbb.co/), and follow the following steps: 1. Go to the "Apps" tab 2. Click on "Connect backend" 3. Fill in the form with: Name: Open Data Platform URL: 4. Click on "Test". You should get a "Test successful" with the number of apps found. 5. Click on "Add". That's it. ---

readmeHtml:
Open Data Platform by OpenBB (ODP) is the open-source toolset that helps data engineers integrate proprietary, licensed, and public data sources into downstream applications like AI copilots and research dashboards.

ODP operates as the "connect once, consume everywhere" infrastructure layer that consolidates and exposes data to multiple surfaces at once: Python environments for quants, OpenBB Workspace and Excel for analysts, MCP servers for AI agents, and REST APIs for other applications.

Get started with: pip install openbb

from openbb import obb
output = obb.equity.price.historical("AAPL")
df = output.to_dataframe()

Data integrations available can be found here: https://docs.openbb.co/python/reference

OpenBB Workspace

While the Open Data Platform provides the open-source data integration foundation, OpenBB Workspace offers the enterprise UI for analysts to visualize datasets and leverage AI agents. The platform's "connect once, consume everywhere" architecture enables seamless integration between the two.

You can find OpenBB Workspace at https://pro.openbb.co.

Data integration:

  • You can learn more about adding data to the OpenBB workspace from the docs or this open source repository.

AI Agents integration:

  • You can learn more about adding AI agents to the OpenBB workspace from this open source repository.

Integrating Open Data Platform to the OpenBB Workspace

Connect this library to the OpenBB Workspace with a few simple commands, in a Python (3.9.21 - 3.12) environment.

Run an ODP backend

  • Install the packages.
pip install "openbb[all]"
  • Start the API server over localhost.
openbb-api

This will launch a FastAPI server, via Uvicorn, at 127.0.0.1:6900.

You can check that it works by going to http://127.0.0.1:6900.

Integrate the ODP Backend to OpenBB Workspace

Sign-in to the OpenBB Workspace, and follow the following steps:

  1. Go to the "Apps" tab
  2. Click on "Connect backend"
  3. Fill in the form with: Name: Open Data Platform URL: http://127.0.0.1:6900
  4. Click on "Test". You should get a "Test successful" with the number of apps found.
  5. Click on "Add".

That's it.

It can be installed by running pip install openbb-cli

or by cloning the repository directly with git clone https://github.com/OpenBB-finance/OpenBB.git.

### OpenBB Cookie Cutter

The `openbb-cookiecutter` package generates a structured project folder for creating new OpenBB Python package extensions. Everything you need to get started building with, and using, the ODP framework.
* [Feature] `openbb-cookiecutter`: Extension Template by @deeleeramone in https://github.com/OpenBB-finance/OpenBB/pull/7261

### From FastAPI

You can now instantly generate Workspace, MCP, CLI, and Python interface

aiSummary.oneLiner: Open Data Platform consolidating financial data for analysts, quants, and AI agents.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: OpenBB is an open-source financial data integration platform that aggregates proprietary, licensed, and public data sources into a single, unified interface. It operates on a 'connect once, consume everywhere' philosophy, allowing users to pull in vast amounts of financial data—from equities and crypto to macroeconomics and options. This data is then exposed uniformly to various environments, including a powerful Python API for quantitative analysis, the OpenBB Workspace for visual analysis, and MCP servers to enable AI agents to reason about real-time financial data.
keyFeatures: Unified data access: Aggregates disparate financial data sources into a standardized format.
Python API: Provides a comprehensive Python library (`obb`) for quants and data scientists.
MCP server integration: Exposes financial data directly to AI agents for automated research.
Broad asset class coverage: Supports equities, crypto, forex, derivatives, fixed income, and macro data.
Extensible architecture: Allows developers to easily build and integrate custom data providers.

useCases.title: Quantitative Research
useCases.description: Quants use the Python API to quickly pull historical data across asset classes to backtest trading strategies.

useCases.title: Agentic Financial Analysis
useCases.description: AI agents utilize the MCP integration to fetch real-time stock data and generate automated market reports.

useCases.title: Dashboard Development
useCases.description: Developers build custom financial dashboards by pulling unified data through OpenBB's REST APIs.

useCases.title: Academic Economics
useCases.description: Researchers access aggregated macroeconomic data for statistical analysis without managing multiple APIs.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Quantitative analysts, financial developers, and AI engineers building finance-focused applications. Requires Python familiarity.
